# Salman Mustapa, S.Kom.
> Backend Engineer, Security Engineer (SentinelOne XDR), & Founder of PT SAMRIFA STUDIO TEKNOLOGI

## About
Salman Mustapa is a professional Backend Engineer & Security Engineer based in Gorontalo, Indonesia. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems (S.Kom) from Universitas Negeri Gorontalo (GPA 3.43) and owns 3 registered Intellectual Property Copyright Patents (HAKI Kemenkumham RI, 50 years validity):
1. HAKI 2021: SILET Diskominfo Bone Bolango (No. 000269388)
2. HAKI 2023: Sistem Pengelolaan Sarana Prasarana Laboratorium FT UNG (No. 000480059)
3. HAKI 2026: Calculators IMT / Antropometri Android & Web App (No. 001297659, https://antropometri.samrifa.com)

He is the Founder & Lead Architect at **PT SAMRIFA STUDIO TEKNOLOGI** (Software Studio - PT Perorangan, website: https://samrifa.com).

## Core Capabilities
- **Backend Architecture**: Express.js (Node.js), PHP (Laravel Framework), RESTful API Design, Microservices, WebSockets, SOLID principles.
- **IoT & Telemetry**: EMQX MQTT Broker deployment & scaling, Mosquitto, real-time sensor data ingestion pipelines, MQTT Auth & ACL, TLS/SSL encryption.
- **Cybersecurity & XDR**: SentinelOne XDR deployment, Linux VPS server hardening, threat detection & incident response, network security.
- **Database Systems**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, query optimization, time-series data logging, indexing.
- **Integrations**: Supplying backend APIs & WebSocket endpoints for Vue.js Web Dashboards and Flutter Mobile Applications.

## Work Experience & Key Projects
- **PT SAMRIFA STUDIO TEKNOLOGI** (2024 – Present): Founder & Lead Architect (PT Perorangan). Digital solutions & web development studio (https://samrifa.com).
- **NetraHome (Smart Home IoT Project)** (Mar 2026 – Present): Backend Engineer (IoT Specialist). Express.js backend, EMQX MQTT Broker, PostgreSQL, EMQX Dashboard, APIs for Vue.js Web & Flutter Mobile + AI Token Monitoring.
- **SentinelOne XDR Security Implementation** (Aug 2025 – Present): Security Engineer. SentinelOne XDR deployment, threat detection, Linux VPS hardening.
- **Alps Studio** (Jan 2024 – May 2024): Backend Web Developer (Laravel & Express.js REST APIs).
- **Diskominfo Bone Bolango** (2022 – 2024): Network Technical Support & Server Admin (SILET HAKI 2021).
- **Dinas Kesehatan Kota Gorontalo** (2022 – 2024): Computer Operator & Internal App Developer.
- **Universitas Negeri Gorontalo** (2019 – 2023): Computer Lab Assistant (HAKI Patent 2023).
